description: You probably have 30 tabs open and your friends dms on the side, making 30 headcanons about these characters relationships. Whats better than a bit of drama to heal your pain? Or maybe make it worse.

Even sex needs a build up! To get to the steam your readers will sit through 10k of context and they're going to like it! You have a whole timeline?points?help? planned, though characters sometimes seem to like to deviate away from it. They just simply have a lot to say, and so do you!

Holy baggage. Every inch of your story is full of meaning, your character will be reading Dotoyevski and trying to get their friend back by reasoning. Well, he will try. If he suffers in between, you sure do know how to make it gut wrenching.

You love a good guilt, a bit of spiritual suffering to make the core of your stories full of life. You love making the type of story that have you biting your nails from the narrative and fanning yourself when the heat rises.

You have your set of favorites and they better be ready for everything you'll put them through. They may start not liking it, will Probably make their complaints clear through the story, but the journey will turn them into someone else entirety. If that's good or bad... people need to read to find out, right?

You're Probably messy, and so is your character. A little bit of smut here to make them grow, a little more here to take them down to Square one. You have everything under Control, but the thing worrying you is how many words you can find as a synonym to thrust and how much "Ah" is acceptable to a moan.

The characters are going through their personal TED talks and you're right beside them holding the microphone. The process  is not linear, every decision is a lesson to be learned and shake your readers morality. But Hey, surely everything will be worth it, even if you planned for them to go through all levels of hell Before that happens. Oops?

Nothing is more romantic than questioning your morals halfway through undressing someone. You have an amazing hability in making bad decisions sound reasonable and no one is complaining. Even freud might raise an eyebrow, but you'd probably take that as a compliment.

You started writing with a vague idea and somehow ended up with 17 side characters, three kingdoms, and a whole new language. The plot is lost somewhere between the twenty dialogues about someone's family gossip, but who's counting? You'll eventually find out, even if that sacrifice background character 5 appearance in between.

What just happened? You have no idea.

The plot came to your mind and you opened a document, what came after that was completely out of your hands. Kinda. You love a good backstory, can't live without a proper setting and your characters just can't seem to stop talking even mid sex. Your readers probably aren't complaining though.

You want to read something no one has written yet, and you may have trust your gut a bit too much. This wasn't supposed to be more than 100k and now you're questioning the meanings of life, death and on the verge starting a revolution because a character decided to quote Sartre. Quick, find these ends, they're not tying it by themselves!
